Password stored or matched in cleartext — no hashing is applied anywhere in this module; use bcrypt/scrypt/argon2.
Authentication credential decision has no effective rate limit, lockout, backoff, or CAPTCHA control.

/protected verifies JWT with hardcoded known secret (SECRET_KEY='secretkey'), allowing attacker to forge a token with any user _id; User.findById(decoded.id) then reads that user's username with no ownership/authorization binding to the caller, an attacker-selected object access.

This endpoint is configured with a plaintext http:// scheme and is used elsewhere to transmit a credential (API key, token, or password) as a query parameter or Authorization header, exposing it to any on-path observer.
